# Cursor Pricing in India: Current Plans, Costs and Buying Guide

Current Cursor pricing for Indian developers, including the India-specific Start plan and a verification-first approach to plan comparisons.

## Direct answer

Cursor now has an India-specific Start plan. Cursor's official July 28, 2026 announcement says Start costs ₹649 per month, is tax inclusive, is billed in INR, and supports UPI or card payments. Cursor describes Start as sitting between Free and its higher individual plan, with more agent requests, cloud agents, iOS access, plugins, MCP servers, hooks and skills. Because plan limits and model access can change, the official pricing page is the source of truth at purchase time.

pages.content:
# Best MCP Servers: Security-First Directory and Selection Guide

A security-first guide to choosing Model Context Protocol servers, with emphasis on provenance, permissions, authorization and deployment boundaries.

## Direct answer

MCP servers connect AI clients to tools and data through the Model Context Protocol. Selection should start with provenance: prefer official or well-maintained implementations, inspect the requested capabilities, and avoid granting broad credentials by default. For HTTP-based protected servers, the current MCP authorization specification defines an OAuth-based flow with protected-resource metadata, resource indicators, PKCE and secure token handling. STDIO deployments use a different credential model and should not blindly copy HTTP authorization patterns.

# Claude Code Pricing: Plans, Access Paths and Cost Considerations

A current guide to Claude Code access through Claude subscriptions or Anthropic Console billing, with India budgeting considerations.

## Direct answer

Anthropic currently includes Claude Code access in Claude Pro and Max subscriptions, while Anthropic Console provides a usage-billed route. Anthropic's pricing page lists Pro at $20 when billed monthly (or a lower effective monthly price with annual billing) and Max from $100 per person per month. Team and Enterprise access rules differ, and Anthropic notes Claude Code can be pay-as-you-go for some organizational plans. Verify the official page before budgeting because usage limits and tax treatment can change.
